claim: STOP BOREE SOLAR FACTORY AT GEURIE | Valley of the winds ...
summary: Mr Flynn, whose LinkedIn profile says he is a “renewable energy advocate” for New Energy Development, was described as “CEO” when he signed an official document on behalf of Wallaroo Solar Farm in 2021 while he was disqualified. ASIC records Mr Flynn as being a director of New Energy Development until his disqualification in October 2020.
